subject: Mutual action plan & POC risk heatmap
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Dunne <sarah.dunne@lumenai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan & POC risk heatmap

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth for the POC:

1) Success criteria (customer agreed):
- End-to-end latency < 600ms p50 for single-turn inference on representative dataset (avg seq len ~600)
- Accuracy parity within 3% of current baseline on reranking task (per the sample eval set you shared)
- Stable throughput of 30 reqs/min during peak window

2) Proposed evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): data handoff (sandbox dataset + a small set of failing prompts)
- Week 1: Redwood runs baseline eval and provides a tuned config
- Week 2: Customer runs regression tests; we iterate on hotfixes as needed
- Week 3: Final acceptance and performance report

3) Owners:
- Redwood: Alex (overall POC owner), Markus (engineering lead), Monica (success manager)
- LumenAI: Sarah (product owner), security@lumenai.com (security liaison)

4) Known risks & immediate mitigations (initial heatmap):
- Risk A (high): Tokenization bug observed on long prompts (>2048) — mitigation: temporary truncation + prompt-splitting; engineering to triage
- Risk B (medium): SOC2 evidence request — mitigation: provide SOC2 report and audit extracts; Monica to coordinate
- Risk C (low): Dataset schema mismatch — mitigation: sample mapping and lightweight ETL guidance

Please confirm you accept the plan and the owners, and upload the sandbox dataset by EOD Wednesday so we can start Week 1 on Thursday. Attached a first-draft mutual action plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) and the POC checklist.

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Dunne <sarah.dunne@lumenai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: LumenAI Security <security@lumenai.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:37:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & POC risk heatmap

Thanks Alex — the summary looks great and aligns with internal expectations. Two items to flag before we hand off the dataset:

- We reproduced a failure where inference errors occur if a prompt contains certain unicode sequences and length >2048 tokens. That caused a hard crash on our side yesterday (we can share a failing snippet).
- We need a firm commitment on data retention and access controls; our security team wants SOC2 evidence and a quick answer on whether logs can be disabled for trial tenants.

We will upload a sandbox dataset by Wednesday, but we need the tokenization/long-prompt issue triaged quickly. If this is a show-stopper, we need an ETA and an escalation path.

Sarah
Product Manager, LumenAI
sarah.dunne@lumenai.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Mutual action plan & POC risk heatmap — blocking bug & next steps

Markus / Monica / Ben — looping you in on Sarah's note (below). Key asks:
- Triage the long-prompt unicode crash (Sarah says it reproduces on their infra). Severity: potential show-stopper for POC.
- Provide a short-term mitigation we can apply to the trial tenant (prompt-splitting/truncation or input sanitizer) and an ETA for a permanent fix.
- Confirm whether logs can be disabled for trial tenants and what evidence (SOC2 excerpts) we can share immediately.

Initial proposed mitigations:
- Short-term: enable server-side prompt-splitting + reject-and-echo for suspect unicode sequences (config toggle we can apply to the trial tenant today).
- Mid-term: engineering hotfix to the tokenizer module; target QA + staging by Thu (48–72h) and canary in trial tenant before EOD Fri.

I'll volunteer to be primary contact for LumenAI while Monica handles security artifacts. Ben — can you prepare a brief escalation note for sales leadership if this drags past 48h?

Alex — thanks for the heads up. Quick internal plan:

1) Immediate (within 4h): ops to apply input sanitizer + prompt-splitter to LumenAI trial stack (temporary config flag). This should prevent the hard crash and allow the POC to proceed with the sandbox dataset.
2) Engineering (next 48–72h): reproduce locally with Sarah's log (attached) and push tokenizer patch to QA. If QA passes, we push canary to the trial tenant for validation.
3) Escalation ladder:
   - T+48h unresolved -> Eskalate to Eng Director (Rishi Malhotra) and SVP Sales (Vanessa Ortiz) for business decision and potential credit/extension.
   - Security hold -> Monica to send SOC2 attestation packet and confirm log disabling options (we can disable full audit logs for trial tenants but keep minimal telemetry for bug triage; will be documented).

Risk heatmap (current):
- Tokenization crash: high -> mitigation: prompt-splitting today, patch by Thu
- SOC2 evidence lag: medium -> mitigation: Monica to deliver packet by EOD today
- Performance regression risk after hotfix: low -> mitigation: quick perf sanity run in canary

I'll start the sanitizer rollout now and update every 4 hours. If Sarah signs off on the temporary mitigation, we can proceed with the planned Week 1 activities.

-Markus
